faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JIPMER Project Nurse-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the JIPMER Project Nurse-II position is 15th September 2026. Ensure you submit your application well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Nurse-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a minimum second-class equivalent or equivalent CGPA in a three-year General Nursing and Midwife (GNM) course or a B.Sc (Nursing) degree. Experience in clinical research is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Nurse-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Nurse-II post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Nurse-II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 20000 plus 20% HRA. No other allowances are payable.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Nurse-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Nurse-II position at JIPMER.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the JIPMER Project Nurse-II recruitment must be submitted online only.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Nurse-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting based on application and CV, followed by a written test (if more than 10 eligible applicants), and an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for JIPMER Project Nurse-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.answer: This is a project-based recruitment, meaning the position is for a specific research project.
